messages:
maria: Quick sync — Ember Meetup is in 3 weeks. Need final booth staff rota, speaker handoff, and swag split. Can ppl confirm headcount & shipping preference by EOD?

sam: On it. Sending updated staff grid by tomorrow. Prefer one pallet to venue receiving. :truck:

lee: Venue accepts pallets but needs load-in window Mon 9–11am. I'll book local trucks. Any bulky demo hardware?

devin: I can bring 2 laptops + 1 monitor. Shipping label to our office is fine — no need to send to venue early.

maria: Ok noted. @devin can you also export a list of demo apps we need on machines?

devin: Yep — will push a short checklist to the thread by EOD.

anya: Messaging note: we should run an A/B for the launch post at the booth. Variant A: focus on latency wins, Variant B: focus on cost/perf. I'll draft both.

maria: Perf stat we want to lead with is `1.8x p50 latency reduction vs baseline` — use `p50` not 'median' in copy.

sam: Swag status — placed order: `ORDER-EMB-89734`. Items:
```
shirts x150 (unisex)
stickers x500
postcards x300
lanyards x100
```
ETA 10 days from today.

lee: Budget ok for 150 shirts? Confirm before finalizing sizes.

maria: Budget approved. Final counts: shirts=150, stickers=500, postcards=300, lanyards=100.

swag-bot: Shipment created — tracking `TRK-XYZ123`. Pallet dims 48x40x52 in, weight 620 lbs. Arrival window Tue 9am-1pm.

maria: Lead routing: capture form should post to HubSpot list `ember-2026` and tag leads `event:ember`. QR on table -> short qual form. @devin you'll take SLA for follow-ups?

devin: I'll own follow-up. Planning templated outreach + calendar invite for post-event demo.

anya: I'll set up the post-event webinar invite and a follow-up email flow (2 days, 7 days) — will wire up UTM params for attribution.

maria: Demo shifts: 10:30-12, 12-2, 2-4. Need 1 engineer each slot. @sam @devin can you cover 10:30 and 2?

sam: I can do 10:30.

devin: I can cover 2.

lee: I can take 12.

maria: Awesome — I'll update the rota and add to #events-calendar. Final asks: anyone want to rehearse demos Wed morning? Small run-through (20m).

sam: I can do Wed 10am.

anya: I'll review the booth copy and A/B posts Wed after the demo rehearsal.

maria: Perfect — thanks everyone :tada:
